cis_text.title: Encrypt Data on End-User Devices

ai_guidance.llm: Ensure that all endpoints used for AI work are using encrypted storage to ensure all the LLM assets on such endpoints (e.g., local prompt/output caches and local vector stores) are properly protected and require MDM controls to enforce this.
ai_guidance.agent: Enforce encryption for local agent memory, logs, and tool caches stored on end-user devices running embedded agents. Local agents may cache sensitive retrieval content or conversation history. Encryption protects this data from physical theft or unauthorized access on the device.
ai_guidance.mcp:
Use full-disk encryption on endpoints that run stdio servers which may access sensitive data or cache resources. stdio servers run with user privileges and can read files and environment variables. Define allowed data classes for (a) tool parameters, (b) tool outputs, (c) resource payloads, and (d) prompt/context injection, and enforce these rules at the server or gateway boundary.

NOTE: These Safeguards represent “Compensating Controls” for local stdio deployments where protocol-level network isolation is not possible.

evidence.rationale: Encryption on endpoints reduces the value of locally collected data and raises the bar for simple exfiltration after collection.
Encryption protects copied endpoint data stored on removable media from unauthorized disclosure.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
Claims use ATT&CK Enterprise 16.1, the version that the source mapping uses. See later_version for changes in newer versions.
CIS claims (cis_claims and cis/safeguards) use ATT&CK Enterprise 19.1, the version that the CIS mapping uses.

ATLAS results describe the ATLAS release in versions.atlas, pinned by commit and digest. ATLAS changes often: a later release can add techniques and mitigations. An empty mitigation list means that this release links no mitigation, not that no mitigation exists. agent_related is derived by this project from names.
